dish.title: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
dish.name: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
dish.description: Black beans simmered with minced chipotle and lime, with quinoa and corn. No extra toppings.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
recipe_version.description: Black beans simmered with minced chipotle and lime, with quinoa and corn. No extra toppings.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Stovetop simmer for quinoa and beans. No oven and no grill. Mild heat from 1 tsp minced chipotle across 4 servings.
recipe_version.doneness: Quinoa is done when the grains are tender, a white ring just shows, and the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes plus a 5-minute rest. Beans are done when hot and coated, about 10 minutes. They are not a soup.

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.note: Dry, rinsed. Two-thirds cup. v1 listed 2 cups cooked and no dry measure. This amount simmers to about 2 cups cooked.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: One and one-third cups, for the quinoa. v1 did not list water.

ingredients.name: black beans
ingredients.note: 15 oz cans, drained and rinsed. v1 said 2 cans and did not name the size.

ingredients.name: chipotle in adobo
ingredients.note: Minced chipotle from a store-bought can, plus 1 tbsp adobo sauce from that same can so the simmer has liquid. The extra tablespoon of sauce is a drafter amount. v1 said 1 tsp minced only.
ingredients.preparation: minced, plus 1 tbsp sauce from the same can

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: Juice of 1 lime in the beans. The second lime is cut into wedges. v1 listed 2 limes and said lime juice without a split.

ingredients.name: corn
ingredients.note: Kernels, canned and drained or frozen and thawed. Not grilled cobs and not creamed corn. Layered, not charred.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.body: Rinse the dry quinoa. Simmer it covered in the water about 15 minutes, until the grains are tender, a white ring just shows, and the water is absorbed. Rest covered 5 minutes, then fluff. This is quinoa, not rice.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.body: Simmer the drained beans with the minced chipotle, the 1 tbsp adobo sauce, and the juice of 1 lime for 10 minutes, until the beans are hot and coated. They should not be soupy and they should not be dry. Cut the second lime into wedges. Start the beans while the quinoa cooks so the 10 minutes sit inside the quinoa clock.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Layer the quinoa, the beans, and the corn kernels. Add the lime wedges. Do not add toppings. v1 said toppings and named none.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Dairy-free because there is no cheese, crema, or sour cream. Canned chipotle in adobo is not contracted, so the meal is not marked plant and not marked HH001-eligible. The legacy dietary tag bowl is a format, not a diet.
allergen_notes: No egg, milk, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish in the quinoa, black beans, corn, or lime. Canned chipotle in adobo is not contracted, so this package does not confirm anchovy, wheat, or soy and does not add them as allergens.
The allergen array stays empty. Notes do not replace the array.

changes_from_v1: The assemble step said toppings and listed none. v2 allows only quinoa, beans, corn, and the second lime.
Quinoa was 2 cups cooked, with no dry measure and no water. v2 uses 2/3 cup dry quinoa and 1 1/3 cups water.
The bean simmer had no time and no heat. v2 simmers 10 minutes. Cans were unnamed. v2 uses 15 oz cans, drained and rinsed.
1 tsp minced chipotle had no simmer liquid. v2 adds 1 tbsp adobo sauce from the same can. Drafter amount.
Two limes were unsplit. v2 puts the juice of one in the beans and cuts the second into wedges.
Clock was prep 15 plus cook 25 equals 40, and the chip said 30. v2 is prep 10 plus cook 20 equals 30, beans inside the quinoa clock.
The tacos spark was dropped. This is a bowl. No tortilla was added.
